name: [Beastyqt] Spearmen longbows
author: ebodur

notes: Split the first 6 Villager between Food (2) Wood (2) and Gold (2).
Make an additional Scout.
Build a House, then a Mill (behind Town Center) with the next Villager.
Next Villager (and the one building the Mill) go to Food.
Research Wheelbarrow.
New Villager (or from Sheep) go to Farm each time you have 37 Wood.
Harass enemy Villager with the 2 Scout (do not loose them).
Build the Council Hall with 3-4 Villager from Sheep.
Build a House.
Send all but 4 Villager from Food (keep Farm) to Wood.
Continue rallying new Villager to Wood.
Build additional Farm with the Villager from Wood.
Build a Barracks when at 75% of Age 2.
Once in Age 2, research Double Broadaxe.
Train Longbowman and Spearman.
The Villager from Council Hall and the next ones go to Wood.
Add additional Farm (up to 10).
Build an aggressive Outpost.
Build a Blacksmith.
Research Steeled Arrow.
Rally new Villager to Wood, build some additional Farm.
Put pressure with Longbowman and Spearman (potentially Battering Ram later).

description: How to Push in Feudal With English in AOE4? (Season 1 Guide)
